LINEAR: Линейон, дæргъмæ гæсгæ (density æххæст нæй). EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(distance*density)). EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((distance*density)^2))

MULTIPLY: heightFog * farFog INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
LIMITED_ADDITION: farFog + max(farFog, heightFog) MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + farFog * heightFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog) AVERAGE: farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5
